blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As Manila Water strengthens its preparations for the anticipated impacts of a looming strong El Niño, the company continues to maximize every available drop of treated water by keeping its non-revenue water (NRW), or system losses, below 15 percent, a performance level comparable to that achieved by many utilities in developed countries. In August 2026, Manila Water recorded an NRW level of 14.65 percent, while year-to-date NRW stood at 14.29 percent.
